summary: Hash API keys and compare them in constant time
description: SEC-23 and SEC-27. API keys are stored as sha256 hashes. Comparison uses compare_digest. hmac_user_id is available for new seat code. hash_user_id stays the CTX-005 sha256 of salt, colon, and user id.
scope: A stored key is the sha256 hex and compare_digest matches only equals
hmac_user_id differs from hash_user_id, which still matches the CTX-005 vector
acceptanceCriteria: hash_api_key('secret') is sha256 hex. secrets_equal is true for equal strings and false for secret and secret2. hmac_user_id('test-salt', 'alice') is not equal to hash_user_id('test-salt', 'alice'). hash_user_id('test-salt', 'alice') remains sha256 of the bytes test-salt:alice. SEC-23 SEC-27.
constraints: Do not store raw API keys.
Do not compare secrets with the == operator in secrets_equal.
